title: Campaign readout
prompt: Every Monday, pull last week’s web, ad, and channel numbers from Amplitude and BigQuery, compare to the week before, flag anything that moved more than 10%, and put it in a deck I can review before it goes out.
description: Set it up once. Every Monday, Claude pulls last week’s web, ad, and channel numbers from Amplitude and BigQuery, flags anything that moved more than 10%, and delivers it to you as a PowerPoint deck.

title: Asset creation
prompt: Build a social set for the Fall Readout using our brand guidelines. Three 4:5 posts — a stat, a headline, and a trend — as one proof sheet.
description: Build on-brand social assets, decks, or landing page mockups quickly. Upload your brand guidelines or writing skill, say what you need, and Claude starts designing. Download a first version and share with Design to polish, or share your project so Sales can build a one-pager without putting in a request.

title: Audience intelligence
prompt: Pull feedback from my Gmail survey label and the #brand-mentions channel in Slack, along with recent social chatter and news coverage. Cluster it into themes and give me a prioritized readout of what needs attention this week.
description: Claude gathers feedback from your Gmail survey label and the #brand-mentions channel in Slack, along with social chatter and news coverage, then clusters it into themes for a prioritized readout or a scheduled digest.

title: Call prep
prompt: Look at today’s calendar and pull recent Slack mentions for each external meeting. Give me a short brief per meeting: who I’m meeting, recent context from Salesforce, and what to bring up.
description: Stay on top of your meetings. Claude reads today’s schedule in Google Calendar, pulls the relevant threads from Salesforce and Slack, and hands you a short brief in Word before each one.

title: QBR deck
prompt: Pull the Northfield record from Salesforce, last quarter’s QBR deck, and my notes from this folder. Ask me anything you need, then build the new QBR on our template.
description: Get ahead of your deck. Ask Claude to pull the account from Salesforce, plus last quarter’s deck and your notes from Google Drive. It can ask clarifying questions, then get to work on the new deck using your company PowerPoint template.

title: CRM hygiene
prompt: Read my last week of call transcripts and notes, then update the matching Salesforce opportunities: next steps, notes, methodology, and competition. Show me the changes before saving.
description: Hand off the upkeep. Claude reads your call transcripts from Gong and your notes, drafts the opportunity field updates in Word, then fills them in Salesforce, with an option to flag and fix data-quality issues across your records with your approval, so you walk into a call with numbers you trust.

title: Earnings comps
prompt: Pull the latest earnings transcript and 10-Q for Dunhollow. Extract guidance, key KPIs, and commentary, compare to last quarter, and build a comps table against these peers.
description: Ask Claude to build your earnings comps. It pulls the transcript and filing, extracts guidance and KPIs, and compares to consensus, then hands you a slide in PowerPoint for the meeting with the full comps table in Claude for Excel behind it.

title: Month-end close
prompt: Here are this month’s regional actuals exports. Reconcile them into one summary, flag any variances against budget, and note anything that doesn’t tie out.
description: Keep your data clean. Ask Claude to reconcile regional exports, each in their own format, into one consolidated summary in Claude for Excel with variances flagged for review.

title: Budget reforecast
prompt: Take my H1 budget model and roll it forward through H2 using this new headcount plan. Flag every cell you change and note anywhere it doesn’t tie out to the original.
description: Keep your budget up to date. Work with Claude to roll H2 numbers forward with a new headcount plan in Claude for Excel, and it flags every changed cell with notes.

title: JD check
prompt: Check this job description against our leveling guide. Give me back an edited version and an interview kit.
description: Ask Claude to review a job description before it goes out. It checks it against your leveling guide for your review, then returns the edited doc in Claude for Word and an interview kit for your final sign off.

title: Survey readout
prompt: Here’s our engagement survey export. Theme the open-text responses, quantify how often each theme comes up, and build the exec readout deck on our template.
description: Hand Claude your open text survey results from a pulse or engagement survey and ask it to group them by theme and get started on your executive deck. Claude gets to work in your PowerPoint presentation. You edit and make it yours.

title: Merit analysis
prompt: Run the merit analysis on this comp data against the budget, then generate a comp letter for each employee from the template.
description: Make compensation packets easier. Run the merit analysis in Claude for Excel, then Claude picks the context back up to draft the comp letters in Claude for Word.

title: Legal research drafting
prompt: Research case law on this issue in our jurisdiction. Verify citations against CourtListener, summarize the controlling precedent, and draft a memo on how it applies to our matter.
description: Start your morning with the research already done. Ask Claude to pull case law from CourtListener, verify citations, and draft a memo in Claude for Word summarizing the precedent and how it applies to your matter.

title: Deposition prep
prompt: Pull every document tagged to the witness in Everlaw, build a chronology of key events, and put deposition questions in a spreadsheet, organized by topic, one row per question, with the supporting document cited and a column to mark each one covered.
description: Walk in with a working list, not a script. Ask Claude to pull the relevant documents from Everlaw, build a chronology, and lay out your questions by topic in an Excel spreadsheet you can check off live.

title: Contract redline
prompt: Counterparty marked up our SOW. Review their changes against our playbook, flag deviations, and output as a doc.
description: Speed up reviewing contracts with connected services like IronClad Contracts and iManage Work. Ask Claude to redline a contract against your playbook in Claude for Word and get back tracked changes for review.

title: Action tracking
prompt: After each of my meetings this week, read the transcript and pull out action items and owners. Post a running list to my team channel and remind owners two days before the next meeting if their item’s still open.
description: Keep everyone in the loop and up to date before and after meetings. Claude reads your meeting transcript, pulls action items and owners into one list, posts it for the team in Slack, and follows up on opens before the next team meeting it sees on Google Calendar.

title: Feedback digest
prompt: Pull customer feedback from Slack, email, and support from the last week. Group it into themes with counts, tie each to a roadmap item, and post the digest to my team channel.
description: Streamline and gather customer insights from multiple places. Claude pulls feedback from Slack, Gmail, support, and survey tools, clusters it by theme, ties it to the roadmap, and delivers a weekly digest in Word everyone can review.

title: Metrics dashboard
prompt: Connect to my analytics data and build a product metrics dashboard: DAU/WAU, weekly retention, funnel conversion, and feature adoption. Explain any trends I should pay attention to this week.
description: Pull data into a dashboard. Claude connects to your analytics services like BigQuery, or reviews an export from Google Sheets and builds a metrics dashboard. It can answer specific data questions with charts.
